title: Robert Martinez, DVM, Clinical Reviewer | BettaFish.website
description: Meet Robert Martinez, DVM, the Certified Aquatic Veterinarian assigned to clinically review BettaFish.website fish-health content.
intro: Dr. Robert Martinez is the aquatic veterinarian assigned to clinically review BettaFish.website disease and fish-health content.

sections.heading: Aquatic veterinary background
paragraphs: Dr. Martinez is a Certified Aquatic Veterinarian in the greater Salt Lake City area and a graduate of the Kansas State University College of Veterinary Medicine.
His public professional biography documents training in aquatic medicine through AQUAVET I and AQUAVET III, experience as an Aquatic Health Advisor, and work with aquarium, zoo and exotic species.

sections.heading: Role at BettaFish.website
paragraphs: Dr. Martinez is assigned to review disease and fish-health guides for clinical accuracy, safety boundaries and appropriate escalation to veterinary care. A guide credits him only after its corrected version has a documented clinical approval.
His review supports general educational content and does not establish a veterinarian-client-patient relationship or replace an examination and diagnosis for an individual fish.
